claims.statement: For a finite bipartite simple graph H, a vertex subset W, integer a=alpha(H), and natural k with 1<=k<=a, let q_j count independent j-subsets of H meeting W. Then k*q_(k+1)<=2*(a-k)*q_k, in integers.
claims.scope: New proposed counting lemma. No leaf, acyclicity, selector, first descent, residual premise or aggregate. A size-restricted incidence count, not the refuted all-window pointwise addability claim.

claims.statement: For a finite bipartite simple graph G, any original degree-one vertex v with support s, a=alpha(G), and integer p>=1 with 3*p>=2*a+1, put H=G-{v,s} and R=G-N_G[s]. Then Delta_(p-1)(H)-Delta_(p-1)(R)<=0, using integer zero-extended counts.
claims.scope: Proposed high-rank proper restriction of pointwise leaf sign. No residual or favorable-selector hypothesis. The refuted unrestricted all-window beta target stays refuted; its witnesses must be checked against this explicit rank condition.

claims.statement: For every finite ordinary tree T with p=alpha(T)-2 as an integer and x(T)+2<=p, where x is first strict negative forward difference, alpha(T)>=7.
claims.scope: Proposed guard lemma for the registered first-interior aggregate only. Does not assert an aggregate sign, no-recovery or unimodality.
